customer:Read-only birthday suggestion;.en: This is only a reminder; you have not started anything yet. Due:
customer:Read-only birthday suggestion;.zh-CN: 这只是提醒，您还没有办理任何业务 · 到期时间：

customer:birthday.reminder_only.en: This is only a reminder: the plan can be previewed once its budget-lock month starts; you have not started anything yet.
customer:birthday.reminder_only.zh-CN: 这只是提醒：锁款月份开始后才能预览计划，您还没有办理任何业务。

customer:birthday.not_eligible.en: This birthday is no longer an eligible calendar event. No plan was created and you have not started anything.
customer:birthday.not_eligible.zh-CN: 该生日已不是可安排的日历事件，没有生成计划，您也没有办理任何业务。

customer:birthday.outside_lock_month.en: This birthday is outside its budget-lock window (the order day's month, before the order time). No plan was created and you have not started anything.
customer:birthday.outside_lock_month.zh-CN: 该生日不在锁款窗口内（订购日所在月份、订购时间之前），没有生成计划，您也没有办理任何业务。

customer:chat.schedule.unresolved.en: I could not tell exactly when to send it. You can say: every month on day 1-28, tomorrow, next Monday-Sunday, the end of the month, YYYY-MM-DD, a month and a day, or a day this month.
customer:chat.schedule.unresolved.zh-CN: 还没能唯一确定执行日期。可以这样说：每月N号（1–28日）、明天、下周X、月底、YYYY-MM-DD、M月D号、当月N号。

customer:chat.schedule.monthly_day.en: Monthly transfers can run only on days 1-28; please choose another day.
customer:chat.schedule.monthly_day.zh-CN: 每月定时转账目前只支持每月1–28日，请换一个日期。

customer:chat.schedule.when.en: When would you like to send it? Please name an exact date, such as tomorrow, next Friday, 20 October or the 5th of every month.
customer:chat.schedule.when.zh-CN: 您想什么时候转？请说明确的日期，例如“明天”“下周五”“10月20号”或“每月5号”。

customer:chat.schedule.number_not_date.en: The day number looks like a room, building or door number, so I did not read it as a date. When would you like to send it? Please name an exact date.
customer:chat.schedule.number_not_date.zh-CN: 句中的“N号”看起来是房号、楼号或门牌，我没有把它当作日期。您想什么时候转？请说明确的日期。

customer:chat.aa.unresolved.en: I could not tell who joins the split bill or what the total is. Write 'me and A, B AA total', or choose the participants on the service page.
customer:chat.aa.unresolved.zh-CN: 还没能确定AA的参与人或总额。请写成「我和A、B AA 总额」，或在业务页选择参与人。

customer:chat.aa.ambiguous.en: One name matches more than one contact; please choose the participants on the service page.
customer:chat.aa.ambiguous.zh-CN: 同一称呼对应多位联系人，请在业务页选择参与人。

customer:chat.aa.complete_prompt.en: Please choose the remaining split-bill participants from your verified contacts below.
customer:chat.aa.complete_prompt.zh-CN: 请在下方从已核验联系人中补全AA参与人。
